gloss: leaving work on time; no overtime

definitions.gloss: leaving work on time; going home at closing time
definitions.explanation: Leaving the office at the official end of the working day instead of staying on for overtime. Often promoted by companies as part of work-style reform.

examples.japanese: {定時退社|ていじたいしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧。
⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{定時退社|ていじたいしゃ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm leaving work on time today.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水曜日|すいようび}→水曜日：00672_suiyoubi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{全社|ぜんしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{定時退社|ていじたいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{推奨|すいしょう}している→推奨する：18699_suishousuru⟧。
examples.english: On Wednesdays the whole company is encouraged to leave on time.

notes:
⟦{定時|ていじ}→定時：07697_teiji⟧ (regular hours) + ⟦{退社|たいしゃ}→退社：06156_taisha⟧ (leaving the office). The opposite of staying for ⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧ (overtime). Many firms set a weekly no-overtime day, often called ⟦ノー→ノー：00324_noo⟧⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧デー.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {定時退社|ていじたいしゃ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to leave work on time
- {定時退社|ていじたいしゃ}{日|び}: a designated leave-on-time day
- {定時退社|ていじたいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{推進|すいしん}する→推進する：17281_suishinsuru⟧: to promote leaving on time
